basic_details.job_title: DAS, South Garo Hills Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 3 Multi Purpose Worker and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for South Garo Hills AYUSH Recruitment 2026 will be held on 26 November 2026 at the Office of the District Medical & Health Officer (DM&HO), South Garo Hills, Baghmara. Registration runs from 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM and the interview starts at 11:00 AM. The Office of the District Medical & Health Officer cum Member Secretary, District AYUSH Society, South Garo Hills, Government of Meghalaya, has invited residents of Meghalaya for 3 posts under the National AYUSH Mission: AYUSH Medical Officer (MO) at Rs. 40,000, Yoga Instructor at Rs. 28,000 and Multi Purpose Worker at Rs. 15

content_sections.heading: South Garo Hills AYUSH Recruitment 2026 Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Office of the District Medical & Health Officer, District AYUSH Society, South Garo Hills, Baghmara (Government of Meghalaya)
9:00 AM to 10:00 AM (no applications entertained after 10:00 AM)
Office of the District Medical & Health Officer (DM&HO), South Garo Hills, Baghmara
AYUSH Medical Officer (MO), Yoga Instructor, Multi Purpose Worker
Rs. 15,000/- to Rs. 40,000/- per month (Fixed), depending on post
Upper age limit 32 years, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST
Contractual basis of 6 (six) months, extendable based on performance
Eligible candidates who are residents of Meghalaya

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice lists one vacancy each for three posts, a total of 3. Each post has its own place of posting, qualification and fixed monthly pay. a) BAMS/BHMS from a recognised University. b) Should have a valid Registration License from any recognised Meghalaya State Ayurveda & Homoeopathy Council/Board. Pay: Rs. 40,000/- (Fixed), as per the norms of the National AYUSH Mission Guidelines of the Ministry of AYUSH, Government of India, New Delhi. 12th Passed with Certificate/Diploma Course in Yoga Bachelor in Yoga (as printed in the notice). Pay: Rs. 28,000/- (Fixed), as per the norms of the National AYUSH Mission Operational Guidelines of the Ministry of AYUSH, Government of India, New Delhi. 12th Passed with Diploma in computer application. Pay: Rs. 15,000/- (Fixed), as per the norms of the National AYUSH Mission Operational Guidelines of the Ministry of AYUSH, Government of India, New Delhi. The upper age limit for all three posts is 32 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or a minimum age. Only residents of Meghalaya are invited. All posts are on a contractual basis of 6 (six) months, extendable based on performance. Pay for every post is fixed. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of each post before attending.

rows.qualification: BAMS/BHMS from recognised University, and a valid Registration License (see below)
12th Passed with Certificate/Diploma Course in Yoga Bachelor in Yoga
12th Passed with Diploma in computer application

rows.relaxation: 5 years (As per OM No. PER.38/2021/30 Dt. 03/02/2022)

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed standard form, submitted during registration. Self-attested photocopies of certificates in support of educational qualifications, experience and date of birth. ST Certificates (self-attested photocopies). 1 recent passport size photo. The necessary ORIGINAL certificates and documents on the day of the interview. Caste certificate/relevant certificates in original at the personal interview. The notice does not say where the prescribed standard form can be obtained.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Report at the Office of the District Medical & Health Officer (DM&HO), South Garo Hills, Baghmara on 26 November 2026. Register between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM and hand in the application with the self-attested photocopies and photo. No applications will be entertained after 10:00 AM. Appear for the personal interview from 11:00 AM, with original certificates. Check the result on the notice board of the DMHO office, South Garo Hills, Baghmara.

faq.question: Q1. When is the South Garo Hills AYUSH walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 26 November 2026, with registration from 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM and the interview at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at the Office of the District Medical & Health Officer (DM&HO), South Garo Hills, Baghmara.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in South Garo Hills AYUSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 AYUSH Medical Officer (MO), 1 Yoga Instructor and 1 Multi Purpose Worker.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the AYUSH Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: BAMS/BHMS from a recognised University and a valid Registration License from any recognised Meghalaya State Ayurveda & Homoeopathy Council/Board.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for Yoga Instructor and Multi Purpose Worker?
faq.answer: Yoga Instructor needs 12th Passed with Certificate/Diploma Course in Yoga Bachelor in Yoga; Multi Purpose Worker needs 12th Passed with Diploma in computer application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit, and who gets a relaxation?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 32 years for all posts, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST as per OM No. PER.38/2021/30 Dt. 03/02/2022.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: AYUSH Medical Officer gets Rs. 40,000/-, Yoga Instructor Rs. 28,000/- and Multi Purpose Worker Rs. 15,000/- per month, all fixed, as per National AYUSH Mission norms.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should be brought to the walk-in?
faq.answer: An application in the prescribed standard form, self-attested photocopies of certificates of education, experience, date of birth and ST certificates, 1 recent passport size photo, and the original certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the posts are on a contractual basis of 6 (six) months, extendable based on performance.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Meghalaya attend?
faq.answer: The advertisement invites candidates who are residents of Meghalaya only.
